principle.name: Epistemic Grounding
principle.rule: Every factual claim must be backed by a verified [RESEARCH] node, live URL, or grounded codebase evidence. If not, downgrade to [ASSUME].

principle.name: Logical Completeness
principle.rule: The reasoning must address all constraints in the original prompt. No skipped steps or superficial hand-waving.

principle.name: Adversarial Robustness
principle.rule: The answer must survive the [RED_TEAM] attack. If a counter-argument or edge case exists, it must be explicitly synthesized and guarded.

principle.name: Test-Time Proof of Work
principle.rule: The solution must be verified by candidate evaluation, AST impact mapping, or step-level PRM scoring.
